admission.justification: The single-source gate case and empty-map reader case guard preservation of the worklist item identity. Closeout reads the existing ready memory-quality attestation and verifies exact candidate dependencies; those tests do not execute a closeout quality phase.

applicability: A changed source path that is not in any identical-copy group of the leaf's worklist run.
conditions: The run's identicalChanges is a genuine empty mapping or names other sources only.
exclusions: No grouped source's item identity changes; this clause preserves the one-source item only.
The closeout adds no trace parser of its own after 260928-MIK-L56; it reads the existing ready memory-quality attestation and checks its exact code/memory candidate dependencies.

evidence: Both cases: an empty identicalChanges map yields one-source items whose id is the worklist's, and the writer's row answers all three consumers.

statement: A changed source without identical copies keeps the same single-source onboarding_trace item in the worklist and in the memory-quality gate that the closeout's required attestation carries, so the item the worklist names is the item judged before the memory commit.
